mapper.sql: select id, care_site_id, person_id, visit_occurrence_id, drug_exposure_id, drug_type, drug_sctid, drug_value, dosage_form, drug_exposure_start_date, days_supply, department_name from mp_drug_exposure
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id id, p.person_id personId, p.visit_occurrence_id visitOccurrenceId, p.drug_exposure_id drugExposureId, p.drug_type drugType, p.drug_sctid drugSctid, p.drug_value drugValue, p.dosage_form dosageForm, p.drug_exposure_start_date drugExposureStartDate, p.days_supply daysSupply, p.department_name departmentName, p.visit_start_time visitStartTime, p.drug_code drugCode, d.drug_name drugName, d.drug_spec drugSpec, d.drug_unit drugUnit, d.drug_form drugForm, d.pharmacology_type pharmacologyType, d.dose_unit doseUnit, d.drug_material_type drugMaterialType FROM patient_drug_info p INNER JOIN drug_dict d ON d.drug_code=p.drug_code
and p.care_site_id = #{careSiteId} and p.person_id = #{personId} and p.visit_occurrence_id = #{visitOccurrenceId} and p.drug_exposure_id = #{drugExposureId} and p.drug_type = #{drugType} and p.drug_sctid = #{drugSctid} and p.drug_value = #{drugValue} and p.dosage_form = #{dosageForm} and p.drug_exposure_start_date = #{drugExposureStartDate} and p.days_supply = #{daysSupply} and p.department_name like concat('%', #{departmentName}, '%')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mp_drug_exposure ( care_site_id, person_id, visit_occurrence_id, drug_exposure_id, drug_type, drug_sctid, drug_value, dosage_form, drug_exposure_start_date, days_supply, department_name ) VALUES
( #{item.careSiteId}, #{item.personId}, #{item.visitOccurrenceId}, #{item.drugExposureId}, #{item.drugType}, #{item.drugSctid}, #{item.drugValue}, #{item.dosageForm}, #{item.drugExposureStartDate}, #{item.daysSupply}, #{item.departmentName} )
